description: This file defines the KafkaClient class within the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically for interacting with the Managed Streaming for Kafka service. It provides method annotations for various API actions such as creating, deleting, describing, and updating Kafka clusters and configurations.

classes.name: KafkaClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with AWS Managed Streaming for Kafka. Extends AwsClient and provides method annotations for Kafka-related API operations.

methods.name: batchAssociateScramSecret
methods.description: Associates SCRAM secrets with a Kafka cluster.

methods.name: describeCluster
methods.description: Returns information about a specific Kafka cluster.

methods.name: updateClusterKafkaVersion
methods.description: Updates the Kafka version of a cluster.
